_readme: Exposure settings, one entry per target image (keyed by filename stem, no extension). Reused as-is by GS, GD, SAIL, and SAIL+ driver scripts -- exposure depends on the physical target/scene, not on which hologram-generation method is running. Values here are human-readable (what you read off the camera's own screen while metering by hand); a separate lookup step converts these to the EDSDK hex codes canon_camera.py's set_iso/set_tv actually need -- not built yet, flagged separately. No Av field: bare sensor, no lens, aperture isn't controllable. ISO: set 'default_iso' once at the top -- most targets should leave their own 'iso' as null to inherit it. Only fill in a target's own 'iso' if that specific target needs to override the default (e.g. a dimly-lit reconstruction needing more gain).
tv_unit: shutter speed as a fraction or seconds, e.g. 1/45 or 2"
